newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan cancels weekly grain tender due to holidays.
newsitem.headline: Japan cancels weekly grain tender due to holidays.

text.p: Japan's Food Agency said on Thursday that it had cancelled its weekly wheat and barley buying tender because of the "Golden Week" holidays.
The agency, which normally holds a tender every Thursday, said it would resume buying next Thursday.
"We bought all our wheat and barley requirements for June shipments in the tender last week, and plan to start buying wheat and barley for July shipments next Thursday," a Food Agency official said.
